name: Photo Caption
description: Title/caption/name/date/folder/location text overlay. Auto-shows on each photo change, then hides via auto-hide.

format.default: title caption name date folder location
format.label: Fields
format.help: Space-separated tokens to show, in order: title caption name date folder location.

date_format.label: Date format
date_format.help: strftime-style format for the capture date, e.g. %b %d, %Y.

font_size.label: Font size
font_size.help: Base text size in design pixels (scaled with the panel).

justify.label: Justify
justify.help: Text alignment: L = left, C = center, R = right.
